mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_disbursement (loan_no, app_no, company_id, company_name, disburse_amount, disburse_date, disburse_account, receive_account, receive_bank, disburse_type, status, operator_name, remark, create_by) VALUES (#{loanNo}, #{appNo}, #{companyId}, #{companyName}, #{disburseAmount}, #{disburseDate}, #{disburseAccount}, #{receiveAccount}, #{receiveBank}, #{disburseType}, #{status}, #{operatorName}, #{remark}, #{createBy})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM loan_disbursement WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(disburse_amount) as totalAmount FROM loan_disbursement GROUP BY status

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN disburse_amount ELSE 0 END) as pendingAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as disbursedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN disburse_amount ELSE 0 END) as disbursedAmount FROM loan_disbursement
